blocks.text: Database data ka munazzam majmua (organized collection) hai jo aik tay shuda banawat (structured format) mein rakha jata hai. Is se data tak pohanchna aur use sambhalna aasan hota hai. Databases aik hi data ki baar baar nakal (duplication) kam karte hain aur bharosa (reliability) barhate hain. Yeh maloomat ko mehfooz rakhte hain aur bohat si qism ke software mein istemal hote hain.
Entity: asal duniya ki koi cheez, shakhs, jagah, waqia (event) ya tasawwur (concept) jis ka data database mein rakha jata hai.
Misal: Student, Teacher, Course, Book, Employee
Attribute: entity ki koi khusoosiyat (property ya characteristic). Yeh entity ke bare mein khaas maloomat batata hai.
Misal: Student entity ke attributes yeh ho sakte hain:
Relationship: batata hai ke do ya zyada entities aapas mein kaise juri hain.
Misal: Student Course mein dakhla leta hai (enrols in). Yahan 'enrols in' Student aur Course ke darmiyan relationship hai.
Identifier: woh attribute jo entity ke har record ya object ki alag (unique) pehchan kare.
Misal: Student entity mein Roll Number identifier ban sakta hai kyunke har student ka roll number alag hota hai.

blocks.alt: Student entity ka dabba; baayein taraf us ke attributes ke ovals: Roll Number (neeche lakeer, identifier), Name, Class, Age. Student se 'enrols in' relationship ka diamond Course entity tak jata hai.
